title: Senior Manager, Project Management - External Manufacturing
text:
Rezolute is a pre-commercial ultra-rare disease company focused on significantly improving outcomes for individuals with hypoglycemia caused by hyperinsulinism (HI). Our fully human monoclonal antibody therapy, RZ358 (ersodetug), is designed to treat all forms of HI and has shown substantial benefit in clinical trials and real-world use for the treatment of congenital hyperinsulinism (cHI) and tumor hyperinsulinism (tHI).

**Position Summary**

Rezolute is seeking a proactive, execution-focused project management professional to coordinate external manufacturing programs as the company advances toward commercial manufacturing.

The Senior Manager, Project Management - External Manufacturing will manage integrated plans, communications, and deliverables across technology transfer, GMP manufacturing, process characterization, process validation, and commercial readiness. Working with internal functional leads and contract development and manufacturing organizations (CDMOs), this individual will align schedules, supplier commitments, and cross-functional dependencies with Rezolute’s Plan of Record (POR), supply requirements, and business priorities.

This role owns project coordination and follow-through, not technical oversight. External Manufacturing Operations, Manufacturing Science and Technology (MSAT), Quality Assurance (QA), and designated functional experts retain responsibility for technical strategy, scientific assessments, manufacturing process decisions, and quality approvals.

### **Principal Duties and Responsibilities**

Integrated Project Planning and Execution

* Develop and maintain integrated project plans for external Drug Substance (DS) and Drug Product (DP) programs, defining scope, deliverables, owners, milestones, dependencies, and target dates.

* Align project baselines and supplier commitments with the POR, supply requirements, and approved priorities.

* Monitor critical-path activities and progress against plan; coordinate recovery actions for overdue or at-risk commitments with functional owners and suppliers.

* Assess scope, schedule, and resource changes with accountable stakeholders and route proposed changes through established approval processes.

Communications and Cross-Functional Coordination

* Serve as the project management point of contact between Rezolute teams and CDMOs, facilitating cross-functional coordination and timely communication of changes.

* Lead internal and supplier project meetings, using focused agendas to address progress, upcoming deliverables, dependencies, and decisions required.

* Maintain and distribute meeting records and action items with clear owners and due dates; drive follow-through to closure.

Workstream and Milestone Coordination

* Coordinate manufacturing and milestone readiness by tracking prerequisites, including material availability, documentation, internal reviews, and supplier deliverables.

* Integrate technical and quality review timelines into project schedules, including protocols, reports, and master or electronic batch records.

* Track schedule dependencies associated with change controls, deviations, investigations, and other quality-system activities in partnership with QA and technical owners.

* Coordinate handoffs from development and validation activities to routine commercial manufacturing, tracking agreed deliverables, receiving owners, and outstanding actions.

Risk, Issue, and Decision Management

* Maintain risk, issue, assumption, decision, and dependency logs, including accountable owners and required completion dates.

* Work with functional leads and suppliers to assess execution risks and track mitigation actions and residual risks.

* Facilitate issue resolution and escalate unresolved items or pending decisions, clearly communicating timing requirements and potential project impacts.

Reporting, Scope, and Project Controls

* Provide dashboards and leadership updates showing milestone performance, forecast completion dates, critical-path activities, risks, and decisions or intervention required.

* Partner with External Manufacturing leadership, Supplier Relationship Management (SRM), Business, and Procurement to define milestones, deliverables, assumptions, and timelines in supplier scopes of work.

* Support project-level financial tracking with budget owners, including planned work, supplier milestones, and the budget and schedule impacts of scope changes.

* Improve project management tools, reporting practices, and lessons-learned processes across the external manufacturing network.

### **Qualifications/Requirements:**

* Bachelor’s degree in a scientific, engineering, business, project management, or related discipline.

* Minimum of seven years of relevant biopharmaceutical industry experience, including responsibility for managing cross-functional projects involving CDMOs or other external manufacturing partners.

* Demonstrated ability to manage integrated schedules, critical-path activities, risks, and changing priorities across multiple workstreams.

* Experience coordinating technology transfer, GMP manufacturing, process characterization, process validation, or commercial manufacturing readiness activities.

* Working knowledge of biopharmaceutical manufacturing and cGMP requirements sufficient to understand project dependencies and engage effectively with technical and quality teams.

* Strong meeting facilitation, written communication, and stakeholder management skills, including communication with external partners and senior leadership.

* Ability to translate technical discussions into clear project actions, decisions, and schedule implications while respecting functional decision-making authority.

* Strong organization, attention to detail, and follow-through, with the ability to drive accountability and prioritize independently in a matrixed environment.

* Proficiency in Smartsheet or comparable project management software and Microsoft Teams, Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.

Preferred Qualifications:

* Experience supporting late-stage biologics programs transitioning to commercial manufacturing.

* Experience coordinating DS and/or DP manufacturing projects across multiple external partners.

* Experience working in a small to mid-sized biotechnology company.

* Experience tracking project budgets, supplier scopes of work, and change requests.

Core Competencies:

* Project Planning and Controls: Creates practical plans that connect workstreams and support timely delivery.

* Execution and Accountability: Establishes ownership and follows through on commitments.

* Communication and Collaboration: Builds productive relationships and keeps internal and external teams aligned.

* Risk and Issue Management: Anticipates challenges, coordinates mitigation, and escalates appropriately.

* Adaptability and Prioritization: Adjusts plans as circumstances change while maintaining focus on program objectives.

Rezolute (RZLT) currently anticipates the base salary for Senior Manager - Project Management External Manufacturing role could range from $165,000 to $180,000 and will depend, in part, on the successful candidate’s geographical location and their qualifications for the role, including education and experience. This position will also be eligible for an annual performance bonus in accordance with the terms of the applicable plan (depending, in part, on company and individual performance and at the Company’s discretion on an individual basis). The compensation described above is subject to change and could be higher or lower than the range described based on current market survey data and the qualifications, education, experience and geographical location of the selected candidate.

Qualifying employees are eligible to participate in benefit programs such as:

* Health Insurance (Medical / Dental / Vision)

* Disability, Life & Long-Term Care Insurance

* Holiday Pay

* Tracking Free Vacation Program

* 401(k) Plan Match

* Educational Assistance Benefit

* Fitness Center Reimbursement
